WITH circuit_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.circuitId,
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) AS circuit_avg_round
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country
),
country_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    c.country,
    AVG(r.round) AS country_avg_round
  FROM races r
  INNER JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
)
SELECT 
  ca.circuitId,
  ca.country,
  ca.circuit_avg_round,
  ca.circuit_avg_round - cya.country_avg_round AS diff
FROM circuit_avg ca
LEFT JOIN country_avg cya ON ca.country = cya.country
ORDER BY diff DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
